skin.text:
The skin is lighter than it was. The master shakes it, listens, and puts it down without saying anything. The coast is a line of pale rock and the next anchorage is not close.

"There is a pool in the rocks," one of the men says. "It is not clean."

choices.text: Ration what is left and keep rowing.
Ask the crew to share their own water.

provenance.notes: A discrete thirst scene, not a water meter.
